Upon activation, this call closes all one on one chats, all alliance chats, all sacrifice chats, and trumps all communication and isolation abilities. Heralds may only converse with each other in the Glandore chat. Sacrifice will conclude as usual, though sacrifice results will be public for all Heralds. During this call, Cliodhna receives periodic updates on the votes of each realm, including only the number of votes each Herald is receiving. She may assign each bird to a Herald, granting them a minor passive ability for as long as the bird remains with them. Alternatively, she may keep a bird for herself, gaining its effect. She may only benefit from one bird at a time. Once per round, Cliodhna may recall any of her birds. Recalled birds become inactive and grant no effects until reassigned. Each bird may be reassigned only once per cycle. Birds begin inactive and provide no effects until assigned. 𝘙𝘰𝘣𝘪𝘯 Passively blocks 1 vote from the bearer each sacrifice. 𝘉𝘭𝘶𝘦𝘵𝘪𝘵 Passively cures the first negative ability that would affect the bearer. 𝘎𝘰𝘭𝘥𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘤𝘩 Passively prevents the bearer from being affected by information-revealing abilities.
